note: Rewritten from the original species-level description by Ahmad (1965), the original in English; it includes the imago and the soldier, the measurements in mm, after his Table 24 (10 alates) and Table 25 (10 soldiers). Type locality Ka-Chong, Thailand, collected on 6 March 1962 (month 3) from a nest on a tree trunk. The author compares it species by species with celebensis, beesoni and uncatus: this species has a weak central line on the postclypeus, larger compound eyes and a distinctly concave posterior margin of the pronotum.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head brown; postclypeus yellowish brown with a weak white central line; anteclypeus whitish, labrum yellow tinged with brown, antennal segments brown; pronotum brown, the disc with a white T-shaped mark and each anterolateral corner with an indistinct spot; abdominal tergites brown. Head with many short hairs and scattered long setae, the postclypeus as densely hairy as the head, the pronotum densely hairy. Sides in front of the compound eyes nearly parallel, the posterior half semicircular, head width without mandibles greater than the length; fontanelle small, circular, near the middle of the head. Compound eyes nearly circular, projecting, one third of their long diameter away from the lower margin of the head; ocelli of moderate size, very broadly oval, their short diameter away from the compound eyes; postclypeus inflated, its length equal to or slightly greater than half its width. Antennae 14-segmented, segment 3 shortest. Pronotum narrower than the head, length greater than half its width; anterior margin nearly straight, posterior margin distinctly concave, sides slightly convex, anterolateral corners broadly rounded. Measurements of 10 alates (mm, mean in parentheses): head length to the lateral antennal base 0.78—0.83 (0.80), head width 0.88—0.93 (0.91), compound eye long diameter 0.23—0.26 (0.25), short diameter 0.22—0.23 (0.22), compound eye to lower margin of head 0.07—0.10 (0.08), ocellus 0.06—0.10 × 0.06—0.07, ocellus to compound eye 0.06—0.07, postclypeus 0.23—0.26 × 0.44—0.46, pronotum 0.41—0.44 × 0.65—0.70 (0.68).

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head yellowish brown, the anterior part of the postclypeus darker, anteclypeus whitish, labrum yellow tinged with brown, mandibles dark brown, pronotum pale. Head sparsely hairy, the anterior half of the postmentum with a few hairs; anterior margin of the pronotum with short hairs, the disc with scattered hairs. Sides of the head parallel, length more than 1.5 times the width; labrum with parallel sides, slightly wider than long, its anterolateral margins meeting at an angle. Mandibles short and stout, incurved at the apex, only slightly longer than half the head length, the serrations coarse. Postmentum 3 times as long as its maximum width, the waist at the basal third. Antennae 13-segmented, segment 3 shortest. Pronotum length slightly greater than half its width, the middle of the anterior margin not distinctly concave, the posterior margin convex and not depressed in the middle. Measurements of 10 soldiers (mm, mean in parentheses): head length to the lateral antennal base 1.43—1.53 (1.47), head width 0.85—0.91 (0.88), head height 0.75—0.85 (0.79), left mandible length 0.75—0.85 (0.78), postmentum length 0.85—0.93 (0.89), postmentum maximum width 0.28—0.31 (0.28), minimum width 0.20—0.26 (0.22), pronotum 0.28—0.34 (0.31) × 0.54—0.59 (0.56).
